props.title: Rename this board
props.description: The interaction target is the document name in the top-left application header.

callouts.text: 1 · Click the filename in the top-left app header. It should become a field here — no modal.
2 · Type series_a_pose_pipeline. The old name should already be selected; the suffix stays protected.
3 · Press Enter to save. Also try F2 → Escape, then click away after editing to commit.
PASS WHEN · The name changes in the header, the green save dot stays beside it, and no Rename document modal appears.
